mapper.select: SELECT mg.CORP_GR , TO_CHAR(mg.TR_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS tr_ymd , mg.TR_CD , mg.FUND_CD , mg.TR_CO_CD , mg.TRUSTEE , mg.JM_CD AS yj_cd , mg.TR_SEQ , mg.CURRENCY , mg.TR_JUSU , mg.TR_DANGA , mg.TR_COST , mg.TR_AEK , TO_CHAR(mg.GYULJE_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS gyulje_ymd , mg.GYULJE_AEK , mg.GYULJE_JM_CD , mg.MK_SUIK_PER , mg.TRANS_RT , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , ya.JM_NM AS xx_yj_cd , mg.PASS_IJA , mg.WON_PASS_IJA , mg.WON_GYULJE_AEK , ya.UNIT_AEK , mg.BS_TYPE , ia.FUND_CURRENCY , mg.FCUR_GYULJE_AEK AS syt0mg_fcur_gyulje_aek , mg.FCUR_SONIK AS syt0mg_fcur_sonik , mg.FCUR_HWAN_CHA AS syt0mg_fcur_hwan_cha , CASE WHEN mg.TR_YMD >= F_WORKDATE(mg.CORP_GR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS p_visible FROM SYT0MG mg , SZM0IA ia , SYM0YA ya WHERE mg.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND mg.TR_YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND mg.TR_CD = #{trCd} AND ia.CORP_GR = mg.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = mg.FUND_CD AND ya.CORP_GR = mg.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = mg.JM_CD ORDER BY mg.FUND_CD ASC , mg.TRUSTEE ASC , mg.JM_CD ASC , mg.TR_SEQ ASC

SELECT t1.CURRENCY AS currency , F_CURRENCY_RT(#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), t1.CURRENCY) AS transRt , ( SELECT ya.JM_CD FROM SYM0YA ya WHERE ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.CURRENCY = t1.CURRENCY AND ya.GYULJE_JM = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS gyuljeJmCd FROM SYX2MM t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.TRUSTEE = #{trustee} AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT SEBU_CD_EFNM FROM SZX0GR WHERE GR_CD = 'B4' AND SEBU_CD = #{trCd} AND ROWNUM = 1
